info.description: Larynth control-plane API v1. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable type URI per code (x-larynth-error-codes). Operations carry x-larynth-min-role, x-larynth-auth, x-larynth-scope, x-larynth-idempotency and x-larynth-sdk.
